title: Chapter 394 The World Collapses
content:
Chapter 394 The World Collapses

"The world is going to collapse."

As he walked, Jing suddenly said this.

"What did you say?"

The three of them stopped, Lu Daosheng and Yueming looked at Jing at the same time.

Jing looked simple at this moment, but the words said were so strange.

"The world is going to collapse."

Jing blinked and smiled playfully.

When he heard Jing say it again, Yueming's expression gradually became solemn.

Lu Daosheng was not much better either. He frowned, stared at Jing, and said, "What world are you referring to?"

Jing stretched out her tender little finger and pointed at her feet, "All."

At this moment, Lu Daosheng was silent.

He didn't know much, he knew his identity, the source of disasters, and could also be said to be part of the world.

It can be said that the world is there, and purity is there.

But now, Jing said that the world is about to collapse.

What the hell is going on?

"Jing, don't scare me, I just left the house."

"This world is obviously in a good mood, how can there be any signs of collapse?"

Yueming looked panicked and his voice was a little anxious.

This reaction is normal, after all, who can still remain calm when he hears the news that the world is about to be destroyed?

But Jing shook his head, "I can feel that the world is on the verge of collapse, but I don't know what the specific problem is."

Yueming looked at Lu Daosheng with a look of help in his eyes, "Senior, do you know what's going on?"

Lu Daosheng didn't say anything. At this time, he was asking about the system.

"system?"

【Only, host】

"The world is going to collapse, is it true or false?"

【The origin of disasters and disasters is true】

Lu Daosheng's expression became a little gloomy.

"What the hell is going on?"

[Host, it's a very simple truth. The world has existed for a long time, but now he is almost unable to hold on]

"What!"

Hearing the system's explanation, Lu Daosheng was a little stunned.

This is really, too sudden.

The world is not eternal.

But he was unwilling to give up.

"System, there should be a solution, right?"

"Maybe, as long as I am strong enough, I can protect this world, but,

At that time, I'm afraid he can protect this world, but he can't enjoy it anymore.

In other words, if he has the power to protect the world, the world will not be able to accommodate him.

Then what should his family do?

Didn’t he do all this just to be with them?

At this moment, the system responded again.

[The host is big, so there is a solution, but this requires the host to find it yourself]

【And the function of the system is to assist the host, that’s all】

After saying that, the system no longer had any sound, leaving Lu Daosheng alone to meditate.

It seems that I am busy again.

but,,

Lu Daosheng withdrew his thoughts and looked at the two of them.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng's aura suddenly began to become stronger.

Seeing this scene, Yueming and the others were shocked.

The fanaticism in Yueming's eyes was almost about to turn into reality. How strong is the true strength of his predecessors?

In the past, he felt that the strength of the Land of Gods was already at the ceiling level of the world, but now it seems that there are people outside of people and there are heavens outside of heaven.

After a moment, Lu Daosheng's breath gradually calmed down.

At this time, even Jing, who is part of the origin of the world, felt very palpitations about Lu Daosheng's strength.

She unconsciously took two steps back, her little head lowering tightly.

On the contrary, Yueming was much better. His body was not unusual, but he just lamented Lu Daosheng's strength.

At this moment, he could not even feel Lu Daosheng's existence when he closed his eyes.

Of course, the most important thing is that he is too weak.

"I have something to do now, so I'll send you to a place first."

Lu Daosheng suddenly spoke and waved to the two of them.

In an instant, a hot light began to emit around the two of them, as dazzling as the sun.

Buzz —

The next moment, the two turned into a meteor and shot towards the depths of the starry sky, leaving only a fleeting and splendid tail light.

And these things were just two breaths.

It was almost time for Yueming and the others to react, but they were already on the road.

"What's the situation? Where are you going to send us?"

Yueming opened his eyes wide and looked at the light of the world surging rapidly behind him, his voice trembling a little.

I don't know if it's because of excitement or fear.

Jing heard this and pouted, "Who are you asking? I still want to know."

However, as soon as they finished speaking, the two of them were suddenly stunned.

Immediately afterwards, a message came into the minds of the two.

"Wild City? Daughter?!"

.........

On the other hand, Lu Daosheng, who sent Yue Ming and the others away, also began his own investigation.

As he had just improved, he immediately noticed the abnormality in this world.

Fortunately, Jing reminded him early that if he found out too late, he might be a little panicked.

"It shouldn't be far."

Lu Daosheng whispered to himself, and tore open the void turbulence in front of him with bare hands and plunged in.

I don't know how long it took.

The originally endless darkness in front of me suddenly appeared a little light.

The next moment, with the light in front of me, flashed.

A shocking scene suddenly appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

"This is,,"

Lu Daosheng couldn't help but lose his mind slightly. Looking at the scene in front of him, the light flowed in his eyes.

I saw a large area of endless fragments of the world scattered on the ground, and on it were countless strange buildings, which were stationed on them without any rules, but just perfectly stabilized these extremely unstable fragments of the world. .

With just one glance, Lu Daosheng understood.

It is true that the world is about to collapse.

And now, creatures have discovered and taken measures.

"Who trespassed in forbidden areas?"

A majestic voice suddenly came from one of the slightly larger buildings.

Immediately afterwards, three figures rushed out and rushed towards Lu Daosheng.

Soon, the three figures came not far in front of Lu Daosheng.

The three people have different forms and are obviously not creatures of the same race, but one of them is a human race.

When the human creature saw Lu Daosheng, his expression lit up and laughed: "It's worthy of being my human race. Now, there is another powerful general in the boundary of the universe."

The two creatures on the side smiled when they heard this.

"Congratulations to Brother Zhao, the human race is really glorious."

"In this way, I may be under a little less pressure."

Listening to the three of them, Lu Daosheng already understood something.

After a moment of silence, he spoke directly, "Human Emperor, can you be here?"

"Um?"

The boundary of the universe, inside the largest ancient house.

A long-haired man sat upright on a high position. He was very handsome, with sword-browed eyebrows and starry eyes, and his eyes were as lightning. He was burly and wearing an exaggerated dragon robe, and his body was filled with a noble aura.

Human Emperor!
